summary_brief: 今日 AI 代理基础设施迎来重大架构升级，多个顶级项目（OpenAI Codex、Continue、Cline、crewAI）集体推出长期记忆、安全沙箱、多模态能力和模块化技能系统等核心能力。Agent 编排框架正从实验性特性向生产就绪演进，同时安全隔离、OAuth 认证和跨平台兼容性成为工程化重点。

engineering_signals.title: AI 代理集体迈向有状态长期记忆架构
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex、Continue、DeepAgents 等多个头部项目同时引入记忆系统（数据库、线程摘要、持久化），标志着 AI 编程助手从无状态对话向具备长期记忆和上下文连续性的智能体演进，这是实现复杂多步骤任务的核心基础设施突破。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 技能模块化与子代理编排模式确立
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 的技能热重载、Continue 的 Subagents、crewAI 的 Provider 重构、DeepAgents 的子代理技能以及 Gemini CLI 的 MCP 技能链接，共同指向 Agent 架构正在从单体向可组合、可复用的模块化能力单元演进，大幅提升了系统的扩展性和维护性。

engineering_signals.title: 统一沙箱与安全隔离成为 Agent 执行标准
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 引入 Bubblewrap 统一执行沙箱、DeepAgents 集成 LangSmith 远程沙箱、Zed 加固终端权限系统并拦截危险命令，反映出 AI 代理在执行 Shell 命令和代码时，安全隔离和权限管控已成为生产部署的硬性要求，避免无限制执行带来的安全风险。

engineering_signals.title: 多模态能力与计划模式提升 Agent 任务可靠性
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI Codex 支持工具返回图片、Gemini CLI 引入计划模式先规划再执行、crewAI 增强 HITL 人机交互，这些改进通过增强视觉反馈、任务规划和人类协作，显著提升了 Agent 处理复杂任务的可靠性和可控性。

engineering_signals.title: OAuth 认证流与远程配置锁定强化企业部署
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 的 OAuth-like API Key Flow 和远程配置锁定、OpenHands 的 reCAPTCHA 用户关联与日志增强、Cline 修复 VS Code 远程环境 OAuth，显示出 AI 工具正加强企业级部署所需的身份管理、安全审计和配置管控能力，解决大规模协作和远程开发场景的痛点。

engineering_signals.title: 流式传输可靠性修复与速率限制智能处理
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: gptme 修复 HTTP 传输错误导致的流式崩溃、Auto-Claude 实现速率限制智能恢复、AgentScope 移除 HuggingFace 依赖以规避限流，反映出项目正通过重试机制、降级策略和依赖解耦来应对外部 API 不稳定性和速率限制问题，提升系统鲁棒性。

engineering_signals.title: 编辑器生态从单一模型向多源预测解耦
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Zed 支持多源编辑预测（GitHub Copilot、Ollama、Codestral）、Dify 优化插件预加载、Zed 增强代码语义高亮和 Diff 侧边对比，展示编辑器生态正在构建可插拔的 AI 能力层，允许用户自定义模型提供商并优化开发体验。

engineering_signals.title: 并行工具调用等特性从实验走向生产就绪
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 将 Parallel Tool Calls 标记为稳定功能、Codex 实现统一执行架构并减少隐式状态、crewAI 进行大规模重构和 Hook 系统改进，表明 AI 编程工具的核心功能已完成验证，正专注于稳定性、类型安全和性能优化，以满足生产环境要求。

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Added a session-scoped “Allow and remember” option for MCP/App tool approvals, so repeated calls to the same tool can be auto-approved during the session. (#10584)
- Added live skill update detection, so skill file changes are picked up without restarting. (#10478)
- Added support for mixed text and image content in dynamic tool outputs for app-server integrations. (#10567)
- Added a new `/debug-config` slash command in the TUI to inspect effective configuration. (#10642)
- Introduced initial memory plumbing (API client + local persistence) to support thread memory summaries. (#10629, #10634)
- Added configurable `log_dir` so logs can be redirected (including via `-c` overrides) more easily. (#10678)

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed jitter in the TUI apps/connectors picker by stabilizing description-column rendering. (#10593)
- Restored and stabilized the TUI “working” status indicator/shimmer during preamble and early exec flows. (#10700, #10701)
- Improved cloud requirements reliability with higher timeouts, retries, and corrected precedence over MDM settings. (#10631, #10633, #10659)
- Persisted pending-input user events more consistently for mid-turn injected input handling. (#10656)

## Documentation
- Documented how to opt in to the experimental app-server API. (#10667)
- Updated docs/schema coverage for new `log_dir` configuration behavior. (#10678)

## Chores
- Added a gated Bubblewrap (`bwrap`) Linux sandbox path to improve filesystem isolation options. (#9938)
- Refactored model client lifecycle to be session-scoped and reduced implicit client state. (#10595, #10664)
- Added caching for MCP actions from apps to reduce repeated load latency for users with many installed apps. (#10662)
- Added a `none` personality option in protocol/config surfaces. (#10688)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.96.0...rust-v0.97.0

- #10595 Stop client from being state carrier @pakrym-oai

key_changes: 新增 MCP/App 工具审批的会话级“允许并记住”选项，避免重复审批
新增实时技能更新检测，技能文件变更无需重启即可生效
为动态工具输出新增文本和图片混合内容支持（app-server 集成）
引入线程内存摘要支持的内存基础设施（API 客户端 + 本地持久化）
新增可配置 log_dir 选项，支持更灵活的日志重定向
ai_summary.summary_cn: rust-v0.97.0 版本主要带来多项用户体验增强功能，包括会话级工具审批记忆、实时技能更新检测和混合内容输出支持。同时引入了内存摘要功能的基础设施，并修复了 TUI 渲染抖动和云需求可靠性问题。整体变更聚焦于提升工作流效率和系统稳定性。

releases.summary:
## New Features
- Added `thread/compact` to the v2 app-server API as an async trigger RPC, so clients can start compaction immediately and track completion separately. (#10445)
- Added websocket-side rate limit signaling via a new `codex.rate_limits` event, with websocket parity for ETag/reasoning metadata handling. (#10324)
- Enabled `unified_exec` on all non-Windows platforms. (#10641)
- Constrained requirement values now include source provenance, enabling source-aware config debugging in UI flows like `/debug-config`. (#10568)

## Bug Fixes
- Fixed `Esc` handling in the TUI `request_user_input` overlay: when notes are open, `Esc` now exits notes mode instead of interrupting the session. (#10569)
- Thread listing now queries the state DB first (including archived threads) and falls back to filesystem traversal only when needed, improving listing correctness and resilience. (#10544)
- Fixed thread path lookup to require that the resolved file actually exists, preventing invalid thread-id resolutions. (#10618)
- Dynamic tool injection now runs in a single transaction to avoid partial state updates. (#10614)
- Refined `request_rule` guidance used in approval-policy prompting to correct rule behavior. (#10379, #10598)

## Documentation
- Updated app-server docs for `thread/compact` to clarify its asynchronous behavior and thread-busy lifecycle. (#10445)
- Updated TUI docs to match the mode-specific `Esc` behavior in `request_user_input`. (#10569)

## Chores
- Migrated state DB helpers to a versioned SQLite filename scheme and cleaned up legacy state files during runtime initialization. (#10623)
- Expanded runtime telemetry with websocket timing metrics and simplified internal metadata flow in core client plumbing. (#10577, #10589)

## Changelog

Full Changelog: https://github.com/openai/codex/compare/rust-v0.95.0...rust-v0.96.0

- #10569 tui: make Esc clear request_user_input notes while notes are shown @charley-oai
- #10577 feat: log webscocket timing into runtime metrics @apanasenko-oai
- #10445 Add thread/compact v2  @aibrahim-oai
- #10589 Move metadata calculation out of client @pakrym-oai
- #10379 fix(core) updated request_rule guidance @dylan-hurd-oai
- #10598 fix(core) Request Rule guidance tweak @dylan-hurd-oai
- #10544 Prefer state DB thread listings before filesystem @jif-oai
- #10614 fix: single transaction for dyn tools injection @jif-oai
- #10568 Requirements: add source to constrained requirement values @gt-oai
- #10611 chore: simplify user message detection @jif-oai
- #10618 fix: make sure file exist in `find_thread_path_by_id_str_in_subdir` @jif-oai
- #10619 nit: cleaning @jif-oai
- #10324 Add a codex.rate_limits event for websockets @rasmusrygaard
- #10623 Migrate state DB path helpers to versioned filename @jif-oai
- #10638 Update tests to stop using sse_completed fixture @pakrym-oai
- #10641 feat: land unified_exec @jif-oai

releases.summary:
This week's release includes support for [multiple edit prediction providers](https://zed.dev/blog/edit-prediction-providers) (GitHub Copilot's Next Edit Suggestions, Ollama, Codestral, Sweep, and Mercury Coder), zooming and panning in the image viewer, Windows as a supported target for SSH remoting, significantly reduced resource usage when watching filesystem changes on macOS, and the ability to rename terminal tabs via right-click or double-click.

## Features

### AI

- Edit Prediction: Added support for multiple edit prediction providers, including GitHub Copilot's Next Edit Suggestions, Ollama, Codestral, Sweep, and Mercury Coder. To configure, open the `Edit Prediction` menu and select `Configure Providers`.
- Agent: Made the message queue feature available for external agents as well. ([#47379](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47379))
- Agent: Added a menu for inserting context more easily with the mouse in the agent panel. ([#47768](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47768))
- Agent: Improved `@` file completions in agent panel to be more accurate. ([#47466](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47466))
- Agent: Improved double-click word selection in Agent Panel to respect punctuation and language-specific word characters. ([#47844](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47844))
- Agent: Added a setting for controlling the behavior of the stop button in the terminal tool call card (between cancelling the command to run and the thread, or just the command). ([#47521](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47521))
- Improved memory usage of large ACP thread diff multibuffers. ([#47526](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47526))

### Git

- Improved the project picker in the Git panel by also displaying the Git status icon on them, to clearly indicate which repos have changes. ([#47752](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47752); thanks [tartarughina](https://github.com/tartarughina))

### Languages

- C/C++: Added highlights for `#elifdef`, `#elifndef` directives and document comments. ([#45672](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45672); thanks [hokein](https://github.com/hokein), [#47556](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47556); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- C++: Added first-line language detection for extensionless libc++ headers. ([#47443](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47443); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- C: Updated tree-sitter-c for highlighting attribute specifier. ([#47156](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47156); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- Go: Improved support to run table-test subtests, handling tests without explicitly declaring variables for test scenarios. ([#46645](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46645); thanks [lzakharov](https://github.com/lzakharov))
- Nim: Updated file aliases so icon is shown for `.nims`/`.nimble` files. ([#47616](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47616); thanks [ire4ever1190](https://github.com/ire4ever1190))
- TypeScript: Improved keyword syntax highlighting for declarations (`const`, `let`, `var`, `function`, `class`, `enum`, `interface`, `type`) and imports/exports (`export`, `from`, `import`). ([#47435](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47435); thanks [ahcurrier](https://github.com/ahcurrier))

### Terminal

- Added ability to rename terminal tabs via right-click context menu and double-click. ([#45800](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45800); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))

### Vim / Helix

- Added relative line jump support to go-to-line action via `+/-/f/b/F/B`. ([#46932](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46932); thanks [KalaayPT](https://github.com/KalaayPT))
- Added a `vim.gdefault` setting to make `/g` (replace all matches in a line) the default for substitutions, along with `:set gdefault` and `:set nogdefault` commands (short forms: `gd`, `nogd`). ([#47664](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47664); thanks [bluetech](https://github.com/bluetech))

### Remote Development

- Added configurable remote server cache retention (default 5). ([#47202](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47202); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Improved error handling in the dev container crate to prevent panics. ([#47513](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47513); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Improved parsing of devcontainer CLI output when using earlier versions. ([#47403](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47403); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Improved error messaging to guide user away from opening a dev container from within a remote project. ([#47816](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47816); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))

### Windows

- Added support for Windows as a target platform for SSH remoting. ([#47460](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47460))
- Added "Reveal in File Manager" to the project panel context menu on WSL. ([#47288](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47288))

### Linux

- Relaxed the checks on `xdg_wm_base` to ensure compatibility with Weston 9. ([#47185](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47185); thanks [linghengqian](https://github.com/linghengqian))

### macOS

- Zed now uses significantly fewer resources when watching filesystem changes. ([#47322](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47322); thanks [marcocondrache](https://github.com/marcocondrache))

### Other

- Added zooming and panning support in the image viewer with zoom in/out, reset, fit-to-view, zoom-to-actual actions, scroll-wheel zoom with modifier, click-and-drag panning, zoom percentage overlay, and toolbar controls. ([#43944](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/43944); thanks [MostlyKIGuess](https://github.com/MostlyKIGuess))
- Added a menu item in the buffer and tab right-click menu for opening Markdown and SVG files in the preview tab. ([#47821](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47821))
- Added commands for extending selections to syntax node boundaries, i.e., `editor: select to start of larger syntax node` and `editor: select to end of larger syntax node`. ([#47571](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47571); thanks [alexispurslane](https://github.com/alexispurslane))
- Added support for specifying multiple snippets paths in extensions. ([#45829](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45829))
- Added `project_panel.bold_folder_labels` to show folder names with bold text in the project panel (defaults to `false`). ([#47631](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47631); thanks [zertosh](https://github.com/zertosh))
- Added a menu item to close the current project, going back to a clean window state. ([#47365](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47365))
- Added support for installing a specific Zed version via the `ZED_VERSION` environment variable in the install script (defaults to `latest` when unspecified). ([#45522](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45522); thanks [mikelneonedwin](https://github.com/mikelneonedwin))
- Added "Reopen with Encoding" feature (currently supported for local files). ([#46553](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46553); thanks [tomopumipumi](https://github.com/tomopumipumi))
- Improved empty workspaces with unsaved files to now restore on startup (hot-exit). ([#46557](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46557); thanks [shfc](https://github.com/shfc))
- Improved performance when a large number of files were open by making background diagnostics more efficient. ([#47510](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47510))
- Improved project search loading UI. ([#47620](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47620); thanks [zertosh](https://github.com/zertosh))
- Improved memory usage of large git diff multibuffers. ([#47524](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47524))
- Changed bold UI text to render using Plex SemiBold instead of Bold. ([#47725](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47725))
- Changed the auto signature popover — `"auto_signature_help": true` — to respect `hover_popover_delay`. ([#46745](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46745); thanks [TheSalarKhan](https://github.com/TheSalarKhan))
- Added server notifications auto-dismiss with `"global_lsp_settings": { "notifications": { "dismiss_timeout_ms": 5000 } }` setting. ([#46708](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46708); thanks [tomatitito](https://github.com/tomatitito))
- Added support for importing VS Code Insiders and VSCodium Insiders user settings (`settings.json`). ([#47247](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47247); thanks [maj113](https://github.com/maj113))
- Block cursor no longer reveals characters within redacted ranges. ([#45549](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45549); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))

## Bug Fixes

- Agent: Fixed old AI text thread sessions failing to open from History when they contain icons that were removed in previous updates. ([#47624](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47624); thanks [lex00](https://github.com/lex00))
- Agent: Fixed a bug where the inline assistant feedback buttons were being displayed despite the setting "Enable Feedback" was turned off. ([#47382](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47382))
- Agent: Fixed cut-off mention creases in the inline assistant. ([#47772](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47772))
- Agent: Fixed message editor stealing focus from other panels. ([#47321](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47321); thanks [fabianszabo](https://github.com/fabianszabo))
- Settings UI: Fixed a bug with the number field rendering of the font weight setting. ([#47384](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47384))
- Vim/Helix: Fixed bug causing normal-mode vim/helix selections to get expanded during `vim::Scroll` commands. ([#47024](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47024); thanks [jrobsonchase](https://github.com/jrobsonchase))
- Rust: Fixed enum variants with no lower-case being highlighted as constants instead of types. ([#45546](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45546); thanks [tacshi](https://github.com/tacshi))
- Fixed typing emoji using the macOS system palette (`cmd-ctrl-space`). ([#47835](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47835))
- Fixed issue where user `.ssh/config` file would not parse if global ssh config file was not present. ([#47310](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47310); thanks [Gaff](https://github.com/Gaff))
- Fixed a bug where `workspace::SendKeystrokes` would not allow remapping keys in different keyboard layouts. ([#47061](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47061); thanks [everdrone](https://github.com/everdrone))
- Fixed a small issue where highlights of the syntax tree view would persist after the view was closed. ([#47638](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47638))
- Fixed a visual glitch with sticky scroll headers in markdown. ([#47314](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47314); thanks [KyleBarton](https://github.com/KyleBarton))
- Fixed alignment of folded directory names in project panel. ([#47648](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47648))
- Fixed an issue where deleted rules from the rules library were getting restored after a restart. ([#47323](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47323))
- Fixed an issue where the terminal would sometimes fail to write shell history. ([#47408](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47408))
- Fixed bracket color not updating when system theme changes. ([#47505](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47505); thanks [smitchaudhary](https://github.com/smitchaudhary))
- Fixed clearing hovered link when no target found. ([#47134](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47134); thanks [cppcoffee](https://github.com/cppcoffee))
- Fixed Conda showing up in terminal on Windows. ([#47261](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47261))
- Fixed extension uninstall button not working when an upgrade is available. ([#47745](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47745); thanks [eureka928](https://github.com/eureka928))
- Fixed language servers unnecessarily restarting when changing `lsp.<server>.settings` configuration. Dynamic settings are now properly updated via `workspace/didChangeConfiguration` without requiring a server restart. ([#47376](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47376); thanks [aviatesk](https://github.com/aviatesk))
- Fixed project-less workspaces not persisting their dock state. ([#45966](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45966); thanks [ppfmagno](https://github.com/ppfmagno))
- Fixed remote server binaries accumulating on WSL over time. ([#47839](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47839))
- Fixed "Reveal in File Manager" not working for WSL remote connections on Windows. ([#47288](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47288))
- Fixed some instances of authentication errors with the Zed API that could be resolved automatically by refreshing the token. ([#47512](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47512))
- Fixed struct union enum outline issues for C. ([#46125](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46125); thanks [ozacod](https://github.com/ozacod))
- Fixed terminal hanging when a child process is killed by a signal (e.g., SIGSEGV from null pointer dereference). ([#47420](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47420))
- Fixed user-defined tasks with unresolved `ZED_*` variables being silently omitted. ([#45621](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45621); thanks [playdohface](https://github.com/playdohface))
- Fixed vim mode incorrectly switching to Visual mode on first project search. ([#44284](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/44284); thanks [MostlyKIGuess](https://github.com/MostlyKIGuess))
- Fixed vim mode paragraph motions (`}` and `{`) to correctly ignore whitespace-only lines. ([#47734](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/47734); thanks [lex00](https://github.com/lex00))
- Fixed a crash in LoadingLabel's loading animation when displaying CJK or emoji text. ([#45632](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/45632); thanks [MomentDerek](https://github.com/MomentDerek))
- Fixed uninitialized var declaration not being shown in outline. ([#46499](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46499); thanks [hokein](https://github.com/hokein))
- Fixed LSP integrations to send language server shutdown requests with correct parameters. ([#46027](https://github.com/zed-industries/zed/pull/46027); thanks [Spirrwell](https://github.com/Spirrwell))
